ai.overview: Nashville SC bring the Belt Holders lineal championship to TQL Stadium for a rematch with FC Cincinnati on November 28th. Nashville have defended the belt 6 times in their current reign and are coming off a 2–0 victory at Cincinnati just three weeks ago. The belt passes to whoever wins, with no polls or committees involved—just the result on the pitch.
key_matchups: Nashville's recent dominance: They've won their last 2 games overall and swept both 2026 meetings with Cincinnati by a combined 6–0 scoreline
Cincinnati's playoff momentum versus Nashville's belt reign: The home side just won 3–1 at Orlando City in the playoffs but face a Nashville team with a 23-3-8 record
Head-to-head history: Nashville lead the all-time series 5-4-3 and have won the last two encounters, both by 2–0
ai.betting_angles: Nashville SC enter as Elo favorites with an elite 23-3-8 record and are riding a 2-game winning streak. They've also shut out Cincinnati twice in 2026, including a 2–0 road victory on November 7th and a dominant 4–0 win back in August. Cincinnati have only won 1 of their last 5 regular season games before their playoff victory, and their 13-12-10 record suggests inconsistency against a Nashville side that has been exceptional all season.
ai.prediction_writeup: Nashville SC have been near-perfect this season with their 23-3-8 mark and have owned this matchup in 2026, winning both meetings by 2–0 margins. While FC Cincinnati showed life with their 3–1 playoff win at Orlando City, they've struggled against Nashville's structured defense, failing to score in either 2026 encounter. The belt has been on the line twice before between these sides, and Nashville's current 6-defense reign suggests they know how to protect it. On the road against a team they've thoroughly dominated this year, Nashville should retain the belt with a narrow victory.
